messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate via gateway-us-west. AlertID: I-233210. Pager triggered to #incidents and on-call.

incident-bot: Symptoms: spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts correlated with 429 fanout from rate-limiter. Summary: 429s upstream -> retry/backpressure -> worker OOMs and 502/504 in frontends.

sara: I’m on-call and looking. pulling dashboards now (grafana -> /dashboards/rate-limiter /api-gateway /model-runtime).

mike: I see a sudden jump in 429s at 03:14 UTC from the new quota-mapper change deployed ~03:10. Policy `tenant_quota_v2` appears to have been rolled to 100% of traffic. The mapping rules are mismatching keys -> many tenants got lower buckets.

devon: Confirming logs: gateway shows repeated 429 then immediate retries from the client side triggering sustained queueing. Workers maxed out memory around 03:20. stack traces show KV cache allocations increasing.

leah: Quick customer impact note: ~3% of API calls in us-west are 5xx; streaming sessions for a handful of mid-market tenants are timing out. CS Slack getting tickets.

alex: tagging @infra-bot to pull k8s pod statuses and current restart counts.

infra-bot: k8s summary: 12 pods in runtime-pool-us-west. 7 pods restarted in last 10m. avg_restarts=0.58 -> spike near 03:20. Node pressure high on gpu-node-07.

sara: Ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert quota-mapper rollout to previous config (canary 10%). 2) Temporarily increase rate-limiter global token-bucket capacity to allow draining. 3) Apply circuit-breaker: route non-critical tenants to fallback model-approx. Who can execute 1 and 2?

mike: I can rollback the quota-mapper canary flag and reapply old mapping. Command: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/quota-mapper quota-mapper=quoter:v2026-03-10` then patch configmap `quota-rules` to previous sha. Doing dry-run checks first.

devon: I’ll open a protective mutex on the gateway retry logic so clients won’t hammer back immediately: patch config `retry.policy.max_attempts=1` and `backoff.base=200ms` to slow down retries.

sara: Mike, please run rollback now. Post the change ID and new config sha. Devon, patch retry logic after Mike. Leah, please coordinate CS comms and collect list of impacted tenants. Alex, keep an eye on node memory.

mike: Rolling back quota-mapper now. `kubectl apply -f /deploy/quota-mapper/rollbacks/v2026-03-09.yaml` -> applying. Patch submitted: roll-233210-R1.

mike: Rollback confirmed, pods are recreating. New config sha: sha256:9f3c... . Quota rules restored to previous mapping.

devon: Patching gateway retry policy: `kubectl -n gateway patch cm retry-config --patch '{"data":{"max_attempts":"1","backoff_base_ms":"200"}}'` -> applied.

infra-bot: Observability: after rollback and retry change, 429 rate dropped by ~60% within 30s; 5xx rate dropping but still elevated.

sara: Next step: increase token-bucket burst: `curl -XPOST https://configsvc/api/v1/limits/global -d '{"burst":4000,"rate":2000}'` (dry-run then apply). Who has permission for configsvc?

alex: I can run the configsvc change. Applying with --dry-run then apply.

alex: Applied burst increase. Confirming via /metrics: token_bucket.available increased from 1200 -> 4200.

infra-bot: Memory pressure easing. Pod restarts now level off. 5xx rate down to baseline within 3m of rollback+burst.

leah: CS update draft: "We see elevated errors earlier this morning caused by an internal quota mapping rollout. We reverted the change and applied mitigations; services restored. Teams may have seen errors between 03:10–03:25 UTC. Root cause investigation in progress; we will follow up." Send when stable.

sara: I’m going to run post-incident checks and start a SEV ticket with timeline. Devon, can you capture logs for the retry cascades and attach a query? Query: `logs: severity>=WARN AND message~"429" OR message~"OOM" | timechart count()`

devon: Logs exported to S3: s3://redwood-incident-exports/I-233210/logs.tar.gz and I added the saved Kibana query: "I-233210-retry-cascade".

alex: Also found a secondary issue: the quota-mapper had an unintended key transform that mapped some tenant IDs to anonymous group which got default low bucket. Adding that to the RCA list.

mike: Note for the postmortem: deployment gating failed — the canary checks didn't surface the mapping mismatch because test tenants didn't cover the transformed keyspace. We'll add targeted tests that exercise tenant_id variants.

sara: Handoff: I need to go offline in 20m. Logging ownership to mike (infra lead) until next on-call rotation. mike, you’re primary on this ticket, devon is to handle logs + runbook edits, leah for customer comms.

mike: Acknowledged. I’ll continue monitoring for 1h and then escalate to SRE manager if we see recurrence.

leah: Sent CS note to impacted tenants and created Zendesk ticket list. Will follow up with précis after RCA.

sara: Closing the active pager for now, leaving incident open for RCA. If 5xx goes back up to >1% sustained for 5m, re-pager. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigations applied (rollback quota-mapper, reduced retry attempts, increased burst). Current status: degraded -> recovering. Assigned: mike.

mike: Adding immediate action items for RCA: 1) add unit tests for quota key transforms, 2) add canary traffic that mirrors tenant_id diversity, 3) add alert for high 429->5xx correlation. I’ll file follow-ups in SEV-233210.

sara: tagging runbook link for future: https://runbooks.redwood/operational/quotamapper-rollback-guide

devon: Also recommend a short-term safeguard: when quota-mapper config changes, pause auto-retry at clients for 5m via a feature-flag. I’ll draft a PR.

mike: Monitoring note: setting a cross-service guard `alert: ratecap-cascade` for correlation ratio > 0.15.

leah: I’ll schedule a customer-facing postmortem email once RCA is complete.

sara: Great. Handing off to mike. Leaving channel.

mike: Taking over. I’ll close with a timeline and postmortem in next 48h. If anyone sees regression, ping immediately.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: status -> recovered at 2332107823. Refer to SEV-233210 for full timeline."
